mmrExplainerCard.baseGainLossDescPost: that determines the maximum variation range.
mmrExplainerCard.baseGainLossDescPre: The actual result (win, draw or loss) is compared to the expected score. The difference is multiplied by a sensitivity coefficient
mmrExplainerCard.expectedScoreDesc: Before each match, the system estimates your probability of winning based on the MMR gap between you and your opponents. If both sides are equal, the probability is 50%. A 400-point gap drops it to about 24% for the weaker side.
mmrExplainerCard.gainLossDesc: Each result changes your score based on the skill gap with your opponents.
mmrExplainerCard.opponentFactorDesc: Beating a stronger player earns more. Losing to a weaker player costs more.
mmrExplainerCard.placementDetailPost: , the sensitivity coefficient is doubled. Your MMR evolves twice as fast to quickly reach your true level.
mmrExplainerCard.placementMatchesPost: calibrate your level — gains and losses are doubled.
mmrExplainerCard.subtitle: Points-based ranking system

teamModeDesc.collaborative: All team members receive the same point gain or loss.
teamModeDesc.individual: Each player is evaluated based on the gap between their own MMR and their opponents'.
teamModeDesc.sharedResource: Beating a stronger team earns more for each member; losing to a weaker team costs more.

teamModeDetail.collaborative: All team members receive exactly the same MMR delta, calculated from the team's average MMR vs the opponent team's average MMR.
teamModeDetail.individual: The calculated gain or loss is adjusted for each player based on the ratio between their personal MMR and the average MMR of their opponents. A player stronger than their opponents earns less on a win and loses more on a defeat.
teamModeDetail.sharedResource: The distribution is inversed compared to individual mode: members whose MMR is close to their opponents' benefit from a more balanced adjustment. Facing a team well above your level amplifies gains on a win.

mmrExplainerCard.title: How does MMR work?
